biography.plain_text: Greg Lindberg is an American entrepreneur who founded Eli Global, later known as Global Growth. Raised in San Mateo, California, by a family headed by an airline pilot, he studied economics at Yale. He built a profitable specialist publishing business and reinvested its earnings in acquisitions across several other industries.

Raised in San Mateo, California, by a family headed by an airline pilot, he studied economics at Yale. confidence.reason: Substantive business reporting and first-person accounts support these historical facts. Promotional evaluations and unsupported outcome claims are excluded.

long_biography.plain_text:
Greg Lindberg's early acquisitions included a travel-ticketing business whose market was being displaced by online bookings. The purchase failed. A subsequent acquisition took his company into medical coding, broadening its products beyond information for home-care agencies. Changes in those agencies' regulations had cost the business more than half its customers within six months.

Another change concerned how his publications were produced. Lindberg opened an office in Faridabad, India, where staff handled page layout, graphic design, marketing and some editorial work. The operation also provided accounting and administrative functions, reducing the costs of running the smaller publishers he acquired.
